1.

All my need my Father knows, Therein I rest, And what is best, He sends me In His grace each day. Well known is the hand that orders All so well for me. Joy and sorrow, in all together Love is manifest.

2.

Though every earthly hope should sink, Tears flow here, Yet He Himself my highest bliss, All in all is He. May I more on Him rely, Walk faithfully here In the calm, blessed certainty: The Father loves me.
